text: Given a client calls tools/list, when the server responds, then it returns exactly the 7 documented epicor_-prefixed tools and no insert/update/procedure-execution tool is present

steps: Obtain a real CData Connect AI account email + PAT with an Epicor Kinetic connection already configured
Run the service locally with those credentials in X-Epicor-Email / X-Epicor-Pat
Call epicor_query_data with a simple SELECT against a known Epicor Kinetic table
expect: Rows are returned as compact JSON matching the shape validated by TC-EPICOR-004/005 against the mocked transport
notes: Needs a real vendor account (CData Connect AI + Epicor Kinetic connection) -- not available to DEV01 in this environment. Not a blocker per references/mcp-track.md 2.5; to be run by the dev leg or QA once an account is available.

text: Given valid credentials and a mocked CData search_context response, when epicor_search_context is called with a natural-language question, then it returns the candidate datasets/fields the mocked response lists
